entries.en: Added clickable `[Image #N]` links that open attached images in the default viewer
entries.zh: 添加了可点击的`[Image #N]`链接，可在默认查看器中打开附加图像

entries.en: Added alt-y yank-pop to cycle through kill ring history after ctrl-y yank
entries.zh: 添加了 alt-y yank-pop 以在 ctrl-y yank 后循环浏览杀戮环历史记录

entries.en: Added search filtering to the plugin discover screen (type to filter by name, description, or marketplace)
entries.zh: 在插件发现屏幕中添加了搜索过滤（键入按名称、描述或市场进行过滤）

entries.en: Added support for custom session IDs when forking sessions with `--session-id` combined with `--resume` or `--continue` and `--fork-session`
entries.zh: 使用`--session-id`与`--resume`或`--continue`和`--fork-session`组合分叉会话时添加了对自定义会话 ID 的支持

entries.en: [VSCode] Added tab icon badges showing pending permissions (blue) and unread completions (orange)
entries.zh: [VSCode] 标签页图标新增徽标：蓝色表示待处理的权限请求，橙色表示未读的完成通知

entries.en: Improved `/theme` command to open theme picker directly
entries.zh: 改进 `/theme` 命令：直接打开主题选择器

entries.en: Improved search UX across resume session, permissions, and plugins screens with a unified SearchBox component
entries.zh: 改进恢复会话、权限和插件页面的搜索体验：统一使用 SearchBox 组件

entries.en: Fixed slow input history cycling and race condition that could overwrite text after message submission
entries.zh: 修复了缓慢的输入历史记录循环和竞争条件，可能会在消息提交后覆盖文本
